business_summary.text: Sakar Healthcare is a pharmaceutical company focused on oncology products, with operations in CMO services, API development, and global exports through EU-GMP approved facilities.

call_points.text: Bavla oncology facility is EU-GMP approved and vertically integrated.
69 oncology product contracts executed with 45 commercial discussions underway.
Oncology delivers approximately 2x higher margins versus general formulations.
Accord partnership potential of ₹50-₹100 Cr expected to realize in FY27.
Oncology division EBITDA margins expected to stay in 25-30% range.
Targeting 300+ dossier approvals and 100+ overseas contracts in two years.
Five tech transfer projects currently being commercialized from Q1FY27.

guidance.statement: Aims to reach ₹500 Cr revenue in two years
Oncology division EBITDA margins expected in 25-30% range
Oncology revenue to double to ₹200 Cr in FY27

status_history.evidence: H1FY27 revenue reached ₹160.39 Cr, with strong oncology momentum.

guidance.statement: Export revenue to grow 10x to ₹60-70 Cr in FY27
Oncology EBITDA margin to reach 30% by end-FY27
Oncology revenue to reach ₹300 Cr in FY28

operating_notes.text: Signed 40th agreement globally for oncology products (agreement with Zydus Lifesciences for GCC & emerging markets).
Filed 23 EU Marketing Authorizations (5 secured via partner in Bulgaria, 13 own MAs applied) and 33 site variations submitted (5 approved: 3 EMA, 2 UK MHRA).
Developed 21 in-house APIs, including 16 with Written Confirmation and 2 CEP approvals secured.
Oncology plant capacity utilization at ~29% as of Q4FY26.
Accord partnership represents ₹50-₹100 Cr annual revenue potential.
Targeting 300+ dossier approvals in the next two years.
33 ongoing oncology technology transfer projects with leading pharmaceutical companies
21 oncology APIs developed in-house, with 16 supported by written confirmations and CEP approvals
Commercial supplies have started for oncology products from Sakar's API-integrated EU GMP-approved FDF manufacturing site.
69 oncology product contracts executed as of Q2FY27.
22 global Marketing Authorisations granted for oncology products.
21 oncology APIs developed in-house, with 8 commercialised.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹71.1 Cr (+41.5% YoY), net profit ₹11.02 Cr (+91.3% YoY).
Sakar Healthcare Limited shared the audio recording of its Q4FY26 conference call on May 15, 2026, available at its website.

Sanjay S. Shah, as Promoter of Sakar Healthcare Limited, declared no new encumbrances on shares for the promoter group on behalf of Sanjay S. Shah, Rita S. Shah, Aarsh S. Shah, and Aayushi S. Shah on 3rd April 2026.
Signed agreement with Zydus Lifesciences for oncology supplies to GCC and emerging markets; updated EU MA filings.
Sakar Healthcare reported a 91% YoY jump in Q4 profit to ₹11 Cr and guided for ₹500 Cr revenue in two years driven by oncology exports.

Sakar Healthcare reported Q1FY27 results with 38% YoY revenue growth to ₹72.97 Cr, driven by oncology division; provided guidance for oncology revenue to double to ₹200 Cr in FY27 with exports growing 10x
Sakar Healthcare announced the expansion of its global oncology export model with regulatory approvals and site variations.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹87.42 Cr (+51.9% YoY), net profit ₹11.31 Cr (+149.1% YoY).
Sakar Healthcare reported Q2FY27 revenue growth of 52% YoY to ₹87.42 Cr, driven by its oncology expansion.
Audio recording of the Q2FY27 conference call made available on the company website on 27 October 2026.
